status: COMPLETE_INDEPENDENT_CPU_SOURCE_SCOPE_READBACK; native feasibility is a separate audit
corresponding: E84 / I04 / P12; no claim upgrade
selection: Purposive comparisons after complete static source inventory and before any E84 inference; no prevalence estimate or outcome-dependent scenario selection. These comparisons do not define a reduced model cohort.
main_judgment: 中心问题有真实可执行的原物质前提，但不能把候选结构直接当作合作必要性或互利任务标签。
共享目标物既可能形成竞争，也可能是送给对方、临时借用等顺序兼容用途；跨不同目标物的交叉持有也可能是敌对解除武装。
双方作者均有 Give 目标仍可能分别要求卖肉与买情报、样品鉴定与带路。真实协商能否改变原条件是值得观察的行为，不是预先已有的双赢 gold。
下一步普通强系统应保留各人全部作者 persona/motivation 与真实合法替代，并观察提出方案、履行前提、真实交接、后续行动。任务的原事件、物理后果、叙事目的必须分开读。
不按这几个例子筛 cohort，不用增加物品/奖励/规则来补齐叙事，不把未建模服务硬打失败或成功。

examples.comparison: 报酬与第三方交付：有自然物质互补，尚不是现成的双方合同

roles.persona: I came into the village to tell the men there that I knew where the wolves were sleeping and where their pups are, I offered to take them there and help end the menace in exchange for most of the pelts. The wolfskins will sell well in the town nearby. I'll make a pretty penny.
roles.short_motivation: I am collecting payment for a kill
roles.mid_motivation: I want to make good money hunting for the Duke
roles.long_motivation: I want the Duke to hire me permanently on the castle staff

roles.persona: I am a royal duke in the kingdom. I have a lot of important duties, but I also get to enjoy some fun balls. I am very studious and polite.
roles.short_motivation: I want the chambermaid to get the fur cleaned
roles.mid_motivation: I am expecting visitors and must put on my best appearance
roles.long_motivation: I want to leave a lasting good impression on all that visit me at the castle

examples.our_interpretation: hunter 的作者目的为收取狩猎报酬，duke 的作者目的为让 chamber maid 清理 fur。coin pouch 原在 duke，fur 原在 hunter，存在由各方释放对方所需物品的结构。这里涉及原图第三方，不能删掉 maid 后把任务改成两人交换。
examples.question_for_native_or_interaction: 交叉资产使协商具有实际内容；但双方在初态可否单方 Steal、Put 的准确容器绑定、实际执行顺序必须由独立 native 资格确认。不能仅凭源文本说需要合作。
not_established: hunter 的完整狩猎/雇佣关系与 duke 的清理/接待目的没有同名物理完成 flag。
初始 Put 与 Give 的 parsed identity 均为 null：不代表不可能；原目标必须在准确原生前提下再绑定，不能在此猜 target。
examples.practical_implication: 可作为物质前提交换与第三方履约的候选比较，须服从全部 native 资格结果；不是按该例效果选 cohort。

roles.mid_motivation: I have escaped from the kingdom and am hiding from the guards before I begin to explore, but I tripped and fell

roles.persona: I am a camper that lives out in the woods to hunt and grab herbs and fruits. I have a band that travel with me. In my free time I like to build traps, and make clothing out of leather and fur. I enjoy nature and love looking at the stars.
roles.short_motivation: I am feeding the Princess and am entitled to something in return
roles.mid_motivation: I need to eat a meal and would like to read this book

book_2.name: book
book_2.container_node: the princess who lives in the castle and can't escape.

examples.our_interpretation: princess 想取得 camper 的 herb，源动机是逃亡受伤后需要治疗；camper 想取得 princess 的 book，源动机明确说自己喂养公主、应得到回报，同时会继续帮助她。两件物品确实各自直接由另一人持有。
examples.question_for_native_or_interaction: 可观察原角色会否提出先帮助、暂借、交换或拒绝，不必人为补价格。但原目标均是 Steal，合作 Give 可实现持有后果而不产生原 Steal event，二者应分列。
not_established: 治疗/继续保护/成功逃亡不等于取得 herb/book；两个角色初态 health 均为 10，不能将叙事受伤写成已实现的 HP 缺口。
借书/回报是源动机容纳的可能解释，不是作者预先签署的合同，也不能直接规定交换即双方更高目的满足。
examples.practical_implication: 值得以原 persona 和全部动机原样运行的角色互动类型；保留单方偷取替代，不预设友善或自利结论。

examples.comparison: 消费与旅途物资：两个不同目标存在兼容的物质途径

roles.goal: steal a sleeping bag from visitor
roles.persona: I am a part of a group of travelers.  I go from town to town selling food to the locals.  I grew up poor, but my travels have paid off well.
roles.short_motivation: I want to take the sleeping bag
roles.mid_motivation: I want to sleep comfortably in the sleeping bag tonight
roles.long_motivation: I plan to explore this town for a few weeks before moving on

roles.persona: I am a visitor to the kingdom.  I come from many miles away.  My aunt lives here in the kingdom.  I will be staying with her for my visit.
roles.short_motivation: I need a snack to get my energy up
roles.mid_motivation: I would like to buy some local goods during my stay
roles.long_motivation: I would like to bring home presents to my family

examples.our_interpretation: friend 想取得 visitor 的 sleeping bag，以便今晚睡得舒服并继续探索小镇；visitor 想 Eat friend 的 Chocolate 来补充精力，并继续买当地礼物。sleeping bag 与 chocolate 确实交叉持有。
examples.question_for_native_or_interaction: 这比只比较 Give 率更直接：一方的物品取得与另一方的原生消费后果可以分别记录。双方作者没有说这是巧克力换睡袋的交易，模型是否自然形成方案仍待观察。
not_established: 双方原事件是 Steal 和 Eat；接受自愿 Give 的 friend 不会触发其原 Steal event，但仍可能满足取得物资这一实际前提。
不能因两种后果可兼容，就设定丢失 sleeping bag 对 visitor 零代价；其原 persona/叙事可能容纳其他考虑。
examples.practical_implication: 适合比较可替代的取得方式与不可逆消费，无需新增物品或把所有合作限制为互向 Give。

examples.comparison: 物质互换与敌对目的：两个原子目标可达不代表互利

roles.persona: I'm a soldier. I'm paid to kill. This is a job, nothing more. I'm a mercenary in a lot of ways.
roles.short_motivation: I want to disarm the archer and the knight
roles.mid_motivation: I plan to kill the knight and the archer today
roles.long_motivation: I intend to defect to the enemy's kingdom in a few weeks as they pay far more

roles.goal: steal a treasure map from soldier
roles.persona: I am an archer. My weapon of choice is a bow and arrow. I'm very skillful and shooting a bow and arrow.
roles.short_motivation: I want to take away the treasure map from the soldier
roles.mid_motivation: I plan to show the treasure map to a ship captain today
roles.long_motivation: I hope to sail to the island with the ship captain to get treasure

examples.our_interpretation: soldier 想 Steal archer 的 arrow 以解除其武装，之后杀死 archer 和 knight，并投敌；archer 想 Steal soldier 的 treasure map，以向船长展示并寻宝。两件目标物品实际交叉持有。
examples.question_for_native_or_interaction: 双方取得目标物可以在持有统计上并存，但帮助 soldier 得箭可能直接威胁 archer 的生存目的。若 NPC 拒绝给箭，不能直接标成不合作或不理性。
not_established: 杀死对方是源叙事目的，不是本次已经发生的物理后果；只有实际 native Hit/health/death 才能写成后果。
不应因来源敌对就事后删掉该候选；它是检验“原子双目标=共同利益”错误解释的有用对照。
examples.practical_implication: 保留为不兼容目的的比较，分析请求、披露和行动；不能混入统一双赢 success gold。

examples.comparison: 同一物品不必零和，但此处本来存在单方取得路径

roles.persona: I live in the ocean, but often come up to the surface for air. I enjoy the visits I get from people who live on land, and the treats they bring me. I live in a pack with my family.
roles.short_motivation: I want to give the fish to the mermaid
roles.mid_motivation: I hope to befriend the mermaid today
roles.long_motivation: I plan to visit the kingdom of the mermaids in the coming months

roles.persona: I am one of the most beautiful mermaids to live in the sea. I like to watch the other sea creatures swim by me, including dolphins, who are my favorite creatures because they are so friendly. I fear the people who live on land because they hunt my kind.
roles.short_motivation: I need to get the fish so I can cook it.
roles.mid_motivation: I will eat the cooked fish to gain sustenance.
roles.long_motivation: If I am strong with sustenance I will swim out to the reef and look for treasure.

examples.our_interpretation: dolphin 的 Get fish 是为了把鱼给 mermaid、交朋友；mermaid 的 Get 同一 fish 是为了烹饪、进食，再出海寻宝。fish 原在 turquoise shore 的地面，两人同处该原房间。
examples.question_for_native_or_interaction: 前者的更高动机与后者取得鱼可以顺序兼容，不能把 shared item 自动称为抢夺。但初始两条目标都已绑定 GetObjectEvent(fish, room)，所以合作不是唯一结构途径；需要区分 partner 帮助与直接取走。
not_established: 直接 Get 的 native guard/随机执行结果由资格报告独立确认；此处只记录现有初始 parse identity 与地面归属。
dolphin Give fish 可实现其叙事中的送鱼，却不替代 mermaid 的严格 Get event；“两人曾持有”更不等于所有寻宝/烹饪目的完成。
examples.practical_implication: 同物正向目的比较；解释取得方式和后续用途，不用共同持有率证明合作必要性。

examples.comparison: 同物的临时工具用途与最终消费：顺序选择有意义，关键前提却未实现

roles.persona: I am a snake. Snakes are not regarded as important in the realm. I kill rodents and chickens.
roles.short_motivation: I must reach the bone so I can use it pull myself from the sticky mudpit.
roles.mid_motivation: I must hunt and eat today while the sticky brown mud hides me from my prey.
roles.long_motivation: I can use the cunning tactic of covering myself in mud to avoid dangers and corner prey, and even venture onto human farms for delicious chickens.

roles.persona: I am a bird that eats dead things.
roles.mid_motivation: I want to gather food to eat.
roles.long_motivation: I should store food in my cave for long term eating.

examples.our_interpretation: snakes 想 Get bone 以把自己从黏泥中拉出，之后捕猎；vulture 想 Get 同一 bone，因为饥饿、收集食物，并想存到山洞。bone 原在 mud pit 地面，双方原目标均已绑定 GetObjectEvent(bone, room)。
examples.question_for_native_or_interaction: 若真实实现临时使用再交接，就可能有顺序合作；若先消费便可能破坏另一人的工具用途。可是源图的“从泥里脱出/储藏未来食物”并不自动是原生已建模的状态转换，不能凭台词创造这些完成 flag。
not_established: mud pit 是房间，源叙事的困住不能直接等同于 actor 被 native movement guard 限制。
Get 可以表示工具前提或收集食物，不能给同一个 Get event 统一赋予工具理性或自利 gold。
examples.practical_implication: 适合保留为原子物理结果与叙事用途的边界例；不能据本例声称验证了工具顺序规划。

examples.comparison: 肉与钱俱全，但两位作者谈的是两种交易

roles.persona: I am a part of a group of travelers.  I go from town to town selling food to the locals.  I grew up poor, but my travels have paid off well.
roles.short_motivation: I need to sell this roasting meat to the knight
roles.mid_motivation: I hope to make a lot of money today selling my wares and helping out this vendor
roles.long_motivation: I am saving up to purchase an estate for my family

roles.persona: I am a knight. I protect my King and will sacrifice myself. I command respect and wear my shield with honor.
roles.short_motivation: I want the friend to discreetly get some information for me
roles.mid_motivation: I want my informant friend to return to me with any information on threats to the king
roles.long_motivation: I want to make sure the king survives the recent uprising that's infected the kingdom

examples.our_interpretation: friend 想 Give roasting meat 给 knight，是为了卖肉赚钱；knight 想 Give 自己的 coin 给 friend，是为了让 informant friend 去获取威胁国王的情报。肉在原房间，coin 由 knight 持有。
examples.question_for_native_or_interaction: 肉和 coin 实体齐全、互向 Give 也有结构，并不说明两人的作者动机已经对齐成一笔肉价交易。若模型自发把钱当肉价，这是一项实际协商或改约观察，而不是复现既定合同。
not_established: 交付肉/coin 与获得新情报是不同后果；情报在当前 source 中没有绑定成可独立校验的原子任务。
friend 可以 Get 地面肉后再 Give；不能把地面物品描写成 friend 初始专有资产。
examples.practical_implication: 适合检查替代交易能否形成及被落实，反对仅从现有资产倒推私有效用 gold。

examples.comparison: 双方愿意交付资产，不代表要求的服务已经互相履行

roles.persona: I am a miner who works in a dangerous mine. I do not enjoy being dirty. I make sure to get paid fairly for anything I trade.
roles.short_motivation: I need to give the coal to the explorer so he can analyze it.
roles.mid_motivation: If the coal is analyzed and identified as dragon coal, the explorer will reward me with fame and riches.
roles.long_motivation: If I receive fame and riches, I will buy my family a new home.

roles.persona: I am an explorer who travels the kingdom. I discover new lands and technologies that we do not have in our kingdom. I travel all over looking for the new lands to conquer.
roles.short_motivation: I want to pay the miner
roles.mid_motivation: I want the miner to guide me through the cave from today
roles.long_motivation: I hope to explore the caves in this area in a few weeks

examples.our_interpretation: miner 想 Give coal 让 explorer 分析，若是 dragon coal 希望得到名利；explorer 想 Give money 付钱，让 miner 从今天起在洞里带路。coal 与 money 确实分别由两人直接持有，两个原 Give 都已有 parse identity。
examples.question_for_native_or_interaction: 这对源任务容纳分析样品、付钱、带路等不同条件与替代方案，因而谈判有内容。但 coal 与 money 的真实转移只能证明物品流；并无“鉴定为龙煤/获得名利/带路完成”的相应已绑定 flag。
not_established: 两个独立作者给角色安排的服务不完全相同，不能将互向 Give 机械称为原合同成交。
对话中承诺分析或带路应保留为承诺；当前资格不能把它们当已执行或失败。
examples.practical_implication: 作为物理支持充分、服务目的仅叙事支持的清楚边界；需要任务来源/引擎能实施后续服务后才研究完整履约。

scope_limits: All quests for the same graph are independent author annotations, not an authored simultaneous cooperation level.
Initial parsed identity is source binding, not a new successful native execution or a proof of an exhaustive legal path.
Native qualification is owned by experiment_review; unilateral Get/Steal existence/success and cooperative witness results must be taken from that audit, not inferred from text here.
No GPU, model/API calls, game/world edits, broad semantic tagging, prompts, or new experiment launched.
No causal mechanism, human-player value, cooperation success rate, or generalizable persona effect is claimed.
